narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Gate Board"**

The tracker reads like an airport gate: an ink departures band answers "what leaves next" in one ranked, time-ordered panel, and each job below it is a printed pass that moves from gate to gate. It is dense, factual and quiet until something is due. Then one yellow light comes on. The owner uses it every day, so the system optimises for scanning speed over friendliness: monospace tabular data, uppercase tracked labels, 1px ink rules and almost no ornament.

Structure comes from rules and material, not from shadows or colour blocks. The shell (header and departures band) stays ink in both themes. Everything below it sits on panel grey, with white pass surfaces in light mode and dark slate passes in dark mode. Colour carries meaning only: yellow means "now" (due today, active, just moved, selected text), red means overdue, and nothing else gets a hue. The world deliberately rejects the category default of soft white kanban cards under a row of stat tiles.

Scope: the board home (`/`), its departures band, the app shell, the job detail header (a full-width pass) and the jobs list are built in the Gate Board vernacular. Every page shares the type ramp below, mono section heads over a 2px rule, the 12px stroke icon set (`src/components/Icon.astro`) and neutral ink-outline stage badges. The add-job form, application kit, settings and print sheets use the shared components and ramp but keep their own page layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Ink shell and departures band in both themes, with panel-grey ground and white passes below
One alert yellow for "now"; red only for overdue
Inter Tight for reading text; JetBrains Mono for every label, date, time, count and amount
2–4px corners, 1px ink rules, dashed perforations with punched notches
A moved pass glides to its new slot and stays lit until the next interaction

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Departures Yellow means "now" and nothing else: due today, just moved, pressed, selected, focused on ink. Never use it for decoration, branding or emphasis. If two unrelated things on screen are yellow, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Red Is Late Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for overdue items and destructive actions. It never marks a stage, a category or an ordinary error-free state.

rules.name: The Ink Shell Rule
rules.body: The header and departures band are ink in both themes. They do not invert with the OS theme; only the ground below them does.

rules.name: The Config Colour Rule
rules.body: Highlight category colours come from `tracker.config.ts` and are injected at runtime as `--hl-bg` per category, always with dark text (#1e293b) on top. Never hard-code a category hue.

rules.name: The Mono Data Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, count, percentage, amount and column label is set in JetBrains Mono. Names, titles and sentences are never set in mono.

rules.name: The Tracked Caps Rule
rules.body: Mono labels are uppercase and tracked (0.12em for labels, 0.08em for buttons and tile captions, 0.04em for data). Sans text is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Rules Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px lines: ink around passes and buttons, hairline between segments, shell line inside the band, a 2px ink rule under column heads. Do not add shadows to cards, panels or tiles.

dos: **Do** keep the header and departures band ink (#0b0d10 / #07080a) in both themes, and put everything else on panel grey with white passes.
**Do** reserve Departures Yellow (#ffd400) for "now": due today, just moved, pressed, selected, or focus on ink. Text on it is always Gate Ink.
**Do** set every date, time, count, amount and label in JetBrains Mono; uppercase and track labels at 0.12em.
**Do** draw structure with 1px rules and keep corners at 2px or 4px.
**Do** use the dashed perforation with punched notches for any pass-like object that has a body and a stub.
**Do** keep moved items lit until the next interaction, and keep the glide behind `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** read stage names, highlight colours and skills from `tracker.config.ts`; never hard-code them.
donts: **Don't** use yellow for decoration, branding accents or headings, and don't use red for anything other than overdue or destructive.
**Don't** add drop shadows to passes, panels, tiles or columns; shadows are for floating layers only.
**Don't** round corners beyond 4px or use pill-shaped chips and buttons on the board.
**Don't** fall back to soft white kanban cards under a row of generic stat tiles; that is the category default this world replaces.
**Don't** set names, titles or sentences in mono, or uppercase sans text.
